title: Cynara scolymus cream for medicinal use
intro: Cynara scolymus cream is a topical herbal preparation made from the leaves of the artichoke plant, which is known for its medicinal properties. It is often used in herbalism to support liver health and detoxification due to its high concentration of compounds like cynarin and flavonoids. The cream may be applied externally to reduce inflammation and promote skin healing. It is also believed to aid in digestion when used internally, though it is typically applied topically. This preparation is valued for its soothing and nourishing effects on the skin and its role in supporting overall bodily detoxification processes.
